announcement.title: Local agents, shared knowledge and collaboration
announcement.description: Create local agents with their own appearance, roles, working rules, conversations and folders. Organize them into families, open side chats, attach files, switch models and ask agents to work together in ordered group conversations. Checkpoints and linked Shared Brain documents keep current context available across turns, resume and compaction. Agent details, files and the native Browser use the existing side panel. The sidebar now switches between Agents and Sessions; ordinary Sessions keep their conversations and drafts. Desktop audio and video previews now play local files correctly. Public bot imports and external history analysis remain unavailable. Known limitations: an automatic follow-up can occasionally be empty even when a peer result is available in Exchanges; closing a native Browser tab can still log a nonfatal error. Native mobile agent screens are not included.
